title: ItPlatformService
description: IT ontology composite — materialization of the ontology.json axes for TogafPlatformService. Typing: extends TogafPlatformService (chain converges to its GSM base). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's globally-unique title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — collision-free instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties). Mounted axes — attributed-to: ProvAttribution; identified-by: ScapPlatformIdentifier; measured-by-service-quality: Iso25000ServiceAdaptability, Iso25000ServiceMaintainability, Iso25000ServiceReliability, Iso25000ServiceResponsiveness, Iso25000ServiceSecurity, Iso25000ServiceSuitability, Iso25000ServiceTangibility, Iso25000ServiceUsability. Source: frameworks/it/ontology.json (static materialization; generator planned).
